svg.title: Contract Readout Non-invertibility and retained data Where M11 Fixed OPE reader and retained remainder Applying q recovers the same channel reader and finite projections. Projection Πm is not inverted; discarded tails are retained as residuals. Label inverse is not an inverse on unreduced histories. Prop. E.1 M12 Contact extensions with subtraction data TZ(g) = T(Lg) on the stated combined integrability domain. Punctured restriction loses diagonal-supported contact information; separately nonsummable pieces are not assigned integrals. §E M13 Gaussian means, covariances and residuals Normalized Gaussian integrals and μ −v = E∗v −P ∗(Av + b), E = AP −I, A = A∗. Replacing μ by −Cb loses the specified mean identity. No probability covariance is assigned to nonsymmetric P. §F M14 Ordered inverse, determinant and quiet-coordinate data C−1 −A = P k≥1(−S)kA on the original norm-convergence domain. Terminal A cannot be removed/commuted; determinant diagnostic alone is not full log determinant. Orthogonal norm invariance does not preserve coordinate boxes. §F
